text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Amazon," huh...
Quite a promising runner has emerged.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Now this really makes me look forward to next year...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's talent-filled run
stirred a quiet buzz among the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, well now, that wasn't half bad, was it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we were expressing our appreciation for her hard work, suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Big sis, you were the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You guys!
What brought you all the way out here?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Well, the customers around me were buzzing about it! Saying, 'Hishi Amazon is coming next year!'"

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"We were just so, so happy!
We had to tell you right away, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Is that so...?
"Hishi Amazon is coming," huh...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Well then,
we can't be taking it easy for too long!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Time to head back to the academy for training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone could stop them, Hishi Amazon and
the dorm residents had already left Hanshin Racecourse behind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the year turns over, we'll finally
enter the Classic year in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route,
or the Classic Triple Crown route...
It's about time I made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, the Tiara route consists of mile and medium distances,
so it seems better suited to her distance aptitude, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, with the Tiara route's Oka Sho
as our next goal, I decided to wait for the right moment
to ask Hishi Amazon what she really wanted to do.
